leadership_meeting.title: Weekly Leadership Sync - Q4 Planning & Execution
leadership_meeting.transcript:
[09:00] Raghav Verma: Welcome everyone to our Monday sync for the week of September 21st, 2026. Let's focus on key Q4 deliverables. Arjun, where do we stand on the Q4 Sales Pipeline Forecast?
[09:03] Arjun Malhotra: Morning Raghav. The initial pipeline looks strong at $4.2M. However, I need to finalize the probability weights. I commit to sending you the finalized Q4 Sales Forecast by Wednesday, September 23 at 5:00 PM.
[09:06] Raghav Verma: Great. Make sure engineering sign-off on enterprise feature support is included in that forecast.
[09:08] Divya Kapoor: Arjun, my team is reviewing the enterprise feature requirements. I will provide the technical feasibility sign-off to you by Wednesday morning, September 23 at 11:00 AM.
[09:12] Arjun Malhotra: Thanks Divya. Moving on to Acme Corp: Vikram from Acme requested a revised pricing proposal with a 15% volume discount. I will draft the revised Acme proposal and share it with Raghav by Wednesday, September 23 at 5:00 PM for executive approval.
[09:18] Raghav Verma: Sound good. Neha, how about the product roadmap v2 deck for enterprise clients?
[09:21] Neha Sharma: I'm finalizing the feature list. I will send the Product Roadmap v2 deck to Arjun by Thursday, September 24 at 12:00 PM so his team can use it for enterprise pitches.
[09:25] Raghav Verma: Arjun, we also need a competitive intelligence update before the weekend customer advisory board meeting.
[09:28] Arjun Malhotra: Understood Raghav. I will prepare the Competitor Battlecard and deliver it to you by Friday, September 25 at 12:00 PM.
[09:32] Neha Sharma: One critical item: We urgently need budget signoff for hiring two Lead Solutions Architects for Q4 onboarding. Raghav, please approve the reorg budget by Tuesday, September 22 at 5:00 PM.
[09:37] Raghav Verma: I'll review the finance numbers today. Also, regarding the Zenith account customer onboarding, someone from security or engineering needs to complete the Zenith security audit compliance review by Wednesday, September 23 at 5:00 PM. Who is taking ownership of this?
[09:41] Divya Kapoor: We haven't assigned a security owner yet. Let's flag this as unassigned until we clarify whether SecOps or Product Compliance owns it.
[09:45] Raghav Verma: Okay, let's keep that open and unassigned for now. Thanks everyone.
